\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[nfig, width=9.2cm, height=6.4cm, xmin=-1, xmax=1, ymin=0, ymax=1.75, xlabel={$\cos\theta$}, ylabel={$\dfrac{4\pi}{\sigma_{\rm tot}}\dfrac{d\sigma}{d\Omega}$}, xtick={-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1}, ytick={0,0.5,0.75,1,1.5}, legend style={font=\scriptsize, draw=none, at={(1.03,0.5)}, anchor=west, cells={anchor=west}}, clip=false]
  % f(c; x) = 3[(1+x)+(1-x)c^2] / (4 (1 + x/2)), x = 4 m_mu^2/E_cm^2
  \addplot[figB, domain=-1:1, samples=60] {3*((1+1)+(1-1)*x*x)/(4*(1+0.5))};
  \addlegendentry{$E_{\rm cm} = 2m_\mu$ (threshold): isotropic}
  \addplot[figG, domain=-1:1, samples=60] {3*((1+0.694)+(1-0.694)*x*x)/(4*(1+0.347))};
  \addlegendentry{$E_{\rm cm} = 2.4\,m_\mu$}
  \addplot[figO, domain=-1:1, samples=60] {3*((1+0.25)+(1-0.25)*x*x)/(4*(1+0.125))};
  \addlegendentry{$E_{\rm cm} = 4\,m_\mu$}
  \addplot[figR, domain=-1:1, samples=60] {3*(1+x*x)/4};
  \addlegendentry{$E_{\rm cm} \gg m_\mu$: $\tfrac34(1 + \cos^2\theta)$}
  \draw[gray, densely dotted] (axis cs:-1,0.75)--(axis cs:1,0.75);
  \draw[gray, densely dotted] (axis cs:-1,1.5)--(axis cs:1,1.5);
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
